_: Ground contact is measured: per-asset designedSinkM comes from the makers' own placements (world/sources/placement/kit-designed-sink.json) or, failing that, from the mesh tell. What survives here is the anchor mode and the buryCapM ceiling per class, plus the policy-fallback sink for assets with neither kind of evidence. assetPolicyEvidence: why an asset row overrides its kit's policy where the mined contact vote is ambiguous (16h round 12). deckClearanceM (stilt policy): the deck top's height above the support surface where the plugins give no evidence (16h round 13). fallbackWaterlineM (16h round 18): the pivot's depth under the water surface a water-class asset takes when no plugin gives it a waterline (evidence policy in the mounts record); only rows that seat water-class assets carry it (water-zero watercraft 0.0, stilt plank ferry 0.12, pad rubble 0.18, dug-in wrecks 0.35), never read from fallbackSinkM. assetPlacement (planner ruling 2026-09-24): a reviewed per-asset row that decides the asset's anchorClass, designedSinkM and/or designedWaterlineM (metres, pivot-relative as in the manifests) ahead of the mined records when the manifests are refreshed (placement_metadata.py --refresh-built-manifests [--kit ID]); evidence policy; every row carries its why and a field it leaves out keeps the mined value.

direct.evidence: Reviewed direct-ground policy matching the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

plinth.evidence: Reviewed plinth policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

pad.evidence: Reviewed graded-pad policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

stilt.evidence: Reviewed stilt/deck policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract. A stilt or quay piece is seated by its DECK, never its leg tips (owner 2026-09-23): with no plugin evidence its mesh tell is the deck top, set deckClearanceM above the support surface, and the legs bury as deep as they need (pipeline/mesh_ground_line.py).

dug-in.evidence: Reviewed dug-in ruin policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

route-structure.evidence: Reviewed route deck/landing policy matching the compiled route-structure grounding contract.

interior-zero.evidence: Reviewed interior-piece fallback: authored interior transforms supply the floor datum, so terrain burial is forbidden.

water-zero.evidence: Reviewed watercraft fallback: water placement supplies the surface datum, so terrain burial is forbidden.

deck.evidence: Reviewed rests-on-a-host policy (16h round 13): a piece built to rest on another piece (the Telvanni treehouse connector on its tree or platform) takes the deck anchor class where its mined contact vote is ambiguous; the host supplies the datum, so terrain burial is forbidden, as for interior-zero.

bmv:architecture/citebosmer/passerelles/.why: Bosmer walkway stair: its bottom tread band lies at the pivot (z 0 to 0.1 m) and its supports reach 1.54 m below. The stair's foot stands on the ground and the supports are buried, so the pivot sits at the ground (sink 0). The mesh-sill tell took the supports' feet (-1.54 m) and stood the bottom tread 1.54 m in the air.

bmv:architecture/philscaves/small/doorca.why: Cave mouth: its walkable floor at the opening (the up-facing band from y 0 to 0.5 m, |x| under 1 m) lies at z -1.36 m, 0.467 m above the mesh bottom (-1.827 m) the door-sill tell took. A dug-in piece's threshold is flush with the approach, so the sill is the ground line and the rock skirt below it buries (owner check-in 2, finding 9).

bmv:architecture/stilthouse/stilthousedo.why: Door leaf 2.35 x 0.09 m with its bottom at the pivot: it hangs on its frame in the stilt house doorway. No plugin places it alone, so the record reads ground/unplaced.

bmv:architecture/stilthouse/stilthouseex.why: The stilt house deck stands 3.462 m (asset metres) above its support surface: the median of BM&V's four placements (3.29 to 3.86 m per placement in asset metres, over lake water on 5 to 7 of 9 samples under the legs; check-in 2 fix, /tmp/wf/checkin2fix/yard/clearance_all.json). A stilt piece is seated by its deck above the water where water covers the legs, else above the ground, so its class is ground, never water; the legs bury as deep as they need.

composite:docks/quay-run-2.why: Two vanilla dock decks (dockstrent01 and dockstrent02) on pilings reaching 6.3 m under the deck top. The vanilla and BM&V placements of those two pieces hold their decks a median 0.672 m above the water or ground under them (258 references; dockstrent01 0.547 m, n 83; dockstrent02 0.711 m, n 175), so the deck stands 0.672 m above the water and the pilings bury. No plugin places the composite itself.

composite:stilt/stilthouse-with-door.why: The stilt house with its door leaf: the shell's deck and the shell's plugin deck height (stilthouseext row, 3.462 m median over four BM&V placements).

htbm:here there be monsters - curse of c.why: HTBM places this Kothringi dock 35 times, always at scale 2.0, with its deck 2.28 m above the ground or water under it (median; 1.14 m in asset metres, p25 1.14, p75 1.165). The 0.35 m default buried all but the rail.

vanilla:architecture/docks/dockstrent01.why: Dock deck at the pivot on 6.23 m pilings: it stands in the water. Vanilla chains these decks on each other (67 of 83 references on another deck), so the contact vote reads deck; the waterline stays the plugin value (67 references).

vanilla:clutter/signage/whiterun/signwrp.why: Sign post 2.74 m tall with its base at the pivot and the arm at the top: it stands on the ground. The plugin vote splits deck 4 / ground 3 / wall 1 because Whiterun sets several posts on stone paving; the plugin sink (n 5) stays.
